The '''Speeder Bike Assault Force''' were a unit of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] equipped with [[Speeder bike/Legends|Speeder Bikes]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] encountered Speeder Bikers during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] as well as the [[Occupation of Bespin]].<ref name="SEMP">''[[Super Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>
